# Modules that are INTENTIONALLY red, one Lake target per line.
#
# The breaker/builder discipline in AGENTS.md has a phase in which a frozen
# red battery exists and its implementation does not. During that phase the
# default build cannot be green, and a trust gate whose control step demands
# a green build cannot run at all.
#
# This file makes that phase explicit rather than letting the gate abort. It
# is self-checking in both directions: an undeclared failure fails the gate,
# and a declared module that is actually GREEN also fails the gate, so an
# entry cannot outlive the red phase it describes.
#
# Removing the last entry restores the original all-green control.
#
# P0: no entries. No packet was frozen yet.
#
# P3 queue-with-sizes and queuing strategies, frozen 2026-09-02 by the P3
# breaker seat. Packet: test/contracts/queue-with-sizes.contract.md.
# Implementation fence: Whatwg/Streams/Data/Queue.lean and
# Whatwg/Streams/Data/Strategy.lean. WhatwgTest.Streams.Data.QueueContract and
# WhatwgTest.Streams.Data.QueueAxiomReport were red here while the names they
# ascribe did not exist. The P3 builder seat landed that surface and removed
# the two entries; no entry remains.
